scope: Exploratory leave-one-source-out development assessment; a separate source calibrates each fold. These are previously inspected sources, NOT final validation.
selection: Whole-clip MUSIQ improvement, estimated correction >= estimated harm; harm threshold calibrated independently with zero observed calibration harm; no population risk guarantee
fold_assignment: Sorted source order; next source cyclically is calibration, all remaining sources train; fixed before reading scores
